Notes before the figure:

- The router says a `block` figure needs `reference/scene.md` and `reference/layout.md` loaded before writing line 2. Those files weren't included in the documentation given to me, so I've written this using only the genre-independent skeleton (header line, `title`, node/edge declarations with quoted labels per the "every label is quoted" rule). If the actual scene/layout syntax differs from what I've guessed for node and edge declarations, that's the seam to check first when validating with `build-svg.js`.
- All five ids are used exactly as specified, and all five connections are drawn as plain edges — no class/styling was added since the description gives no meaning (like "hot path" or "failure") that would need one.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal job"
block caclient "CA client"
block ca "Certificate authority"
block deployagent "Deploy agent"
block service "Service"

edge scheduler -> renewaljob "timer"
edge renewaljob -> caclient "obtain certificate"
edge caclient -> ca "request certificate"
edge renewaljob -> deployagent "hand off"
edge deployagent -> service "restart"
```

Run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js certificate-renewal.fd` to validate and produce the SVG; if the node/edge keywords above don't match what `reference/scene.md` actually specifies, the build errors will name the correct spelling and I can fix it from there.
